trip.title: Dad's 80th in Scotland
trip.tagline: Eighty years, one family, one wee trip to Edinburgh.

activities.name: Dad back from Norway cruise 🚢

activities.name: Dad free from today ✈️
activities.notes: Plan arrivals on or after July 28.

activities.name: Birthday dinner
activities.notes: The night of Dad's birthday. Venue locks once dates are firm.

activities.name: The Open Championship · St Andrews
activities.notes: 155th Open at St Andrews. Practice and championship week.

activities.name: Edinburgh Castle
activities.notes: Historic fortress on Castle Rock above the Old Town, home of the Honours of Scotland (the Scottish Crown Jewels). Classic first-day stop.

activities.name: St Andrews
activities.notes: The Home of Golf: the Old Course, castle and cathedral ruins, Scotland's oldest university and West Sands beach. About 10 miles north of Elie.

activities.name: Walking tour of St Andrews
activities.notes: Guided walking tour with St Andrews Tours (local operator since 2014): town, cathedral, castle, university and the Old Course, about 1.5 hours. Book ahead.

activities.name: Suggested stay: Elie
activities.notes: Beach village in the East Neuk of Fife, near Kathy in Colinsburgh and about 10 miles south of St Andrews. Rental agencies are on the Resources tab.

resources.housing_intro: Shared by Greg: a local in Elie recommends these three rental agencies. Elie is a beach village in the East Neuk of Fife, about 10 miles south of St Andrews and roughly 75 minutes' drive from Edinburgh.
resources.housing_tip: Book early. With the Open at St Andrews in July 2027, the area is likely to be busy even in August, and many houses book up well ahead.

housing.name: Elie Escapes

housing.comment: One of three agencies a local in Elie recommended.
